summary: What the extraction cannot know, for the Kanturu Ruins: its camp's townspeople. MU and OpenMU stand nobody in the Ruins (VersionSeasonSix/Maps/KanturuRuins.cs has no CreateNpcSpawns); Baz and Amy stand here as in Tarkan, Atlans, the Lost Tower and Aida (the user, 2026-10-23: 'lets add kunturu npcs', then 'Both'). With MU's Elpis, brought here from the Tower, which is not playable (the user: 'find better locations for them'). The Gateway Machine stands at its own place in the Relics (the user, 2026-10-23: 'put it where it has to be'). They are world.json's npcs 0-2; these are their figures.

spawns.ours: the camp vault on the grass two tiles off the cobbled way in, beside Amy, turned to the camera (Kanturu's camera puts north at the screen's foot)
the camp potion seller east of the way in, beside Baz, facing the camera
MU's refinery keeper before the north ruin wall, a shrine at the head of the camp, facing the camera
